feeds.title: This Is My South
feeds.description: The website is a travel guide for all things South, featuring accommodation reviews, restaurant recommendations, and activities for all ages and budgets. The website aims to encourage travel to this part of the world by encouraging adventures and sharing stories.

feeds.title: The Southern C Blog
feeds.description: The blog was developed out of a mutual love for the South by creating an online space where like-minded individuals could connect and be inspired. The Southern Coterie is a virtual front porch for Southern creatives and entrepreneurs to share, inspire, encourage and nurture creative minds.

feeds.title: Black Southern Belle
feeds.description: Covers articles on travel, home-decor, fashion, finance, food and drinks, career and much more. Black Southern Belle was developed to inspire a lifestyle brand focused on African-American women with a Southern connection.

feeds.title: Bourbon and Boots
feeds.description: Bourbon and Boots is more than just a lifestyle blog, it's a rustic lifestyle blog and a community of like-minded individuals who revel in the finer things in life - be it bourbon, boots, beer, barrel decorations, or simply a love for the great outdoors

feeds.title: Southern Voice
feeds.description: following a wandering artist as she celebrates life in the South

feeds.title: The Southern Thing
feeds.description: A lifestyle blog that features everyday life, fashion, beauty, shopping, travel, DIY, food, fitness, and more. The Southern Thing created by Dara is a place where she shares, connects and inspires her readers.

feeds.title: A Southern Drawl
feeds.description: I'm Grace White! A 27-year-old, currently residing in Louisville, Kentucky with my hubby, Jordan, and our pup, Jeter. At Southern Drawl, you can expect a daily dose of inspiration with outfits, health & wellness tips, travel guides, and more.

feeds.title: Lonestar Southern » Fashion
feeds.description: Blog covers posts on fashion and its latest trends. Lonestar Southern is a Dallas fashion blog by Kate Padgitt that offers classic, southern style with a dash of current trends to everyone from the college student to the young professional.

feeds.title: Southern State of Mind Blog
feeds.description: The blog covers topics such as style, home decor, travel, DIY & crafts, holidays and parties, and many more. Heather is a lifestyle blogger that hopes to inspire her readers with her Atlanta Lifestyle and HomeStyle blog to enjoy Life in Southern style.

feeds.title: Southern Love
feeds.description: The blog covers articles on the southern lifestyle and also shares recipes, DIY projects, decor, style, and much more. Southern Love was created to give people a real look into the lives of modern day southerners.

feeds.title: My Colorful Wanderings
feeds.description: Articles dedicated to exploring all of the most beautiful parts of the South in a budget friendly but romantic way. We love to hike and find gorgeous waterfalls, the best Southern delicacy in every city and sharing all the best things behind being a Southerner. My Colorful Wanderings is a travel blog dedicated to encouraging average travelers explore Kentucky, Southern USA & beyond.

feeds.title: Waiting on Martha
feeds.description: The blog covers topics such as style & beauty, entertainment, health & wellness, living & home and much more. Waiting on Martha was created with the desire to unite all of the things the writer loves the most in one place. It has been named as one of the top 5 southern style blogs by the southern living magazine.

feeds.title: Awed by Monica
feeds.description: Awed by Monica is a fashion and lifestyle blog run by Monica as she talks about fashion, grace, elegance and a timeless sense of style.

feeds.title: Smart Southern Style Blog » Amazon Fasion
feeds.description: Covers blog posts on style, beauty, travel, lifestyle and decor. Laura created this blog as a place to provide fashion and style inspiration to ladies who want to live a fashionable life without breaking the bank.

feeds.title: The Kentucky Gent
feeds.description: Hey, my name is Josh Johnson. The Kentucky Gent started as a way for me to show that Southern boys have style too. Since the site's inception, it has expanded into a fully fledged men's life and style blog. Consider it the worldwide web's Gateway to the South where I share my passions for fashion, food, grooming, and travel.

feeds.title: Southern Made Blog
feeds.description: The blog covers posts on motherhood, style, beauty favorites, recipes and home design. Ashlie describes Southern living at its finest through her blog as she encourages and inspires women and moms.

feeds.title: Darling Down South
feeds.description: Blogs cover posts on food, style, and travel. Darling Down South is a lifestyle blog that encompasses what it means to be a Modern Southerner giving an experience for readers on how to live the fascinating Southern Lifestyle.
